mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as dateKey, DATE_FORMAT(m.created_at, '%c월 %d일') as displayDate, COUNT(m.message_id) as conversationCount, MAX(ec.emotion_name) as dominantEmotion FROM MESSAGE m JOIN CHAT_ROOM cr ON m.chat_room_id = cr.chat_room_id LEFT JOIN MESSAGE_ANALYSIS ma ON m.message_id = ma.message_id LEFT JOIN EMOTION_CATEGORY ec ON ma.dominant_emotion_id = ec.emotion_id WHERE cr.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(m.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d'), DATE_FORMAT(m.created_at, '%c월 %d일') ORDER BY dateKey DESC
SELECT b.species_type as botKey, COUNT(cr.chat_room_id) as chatCount FROM BOT b JOIN CHAT_ROOM cr ON b.bot_id = cr.bot_id WHERE cr.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY b.species_type

SELECT ma.analysis_id as analysisId, ma.message_id as messageId, ma.dominant_emotion_id as dominantEmotionId, ma.risk_level as riskLevel, ma.is_high_risk as isHighRisk, ma.recommended_action as recommendedAction, ma.analyzed_at as analyzedAt FROM MESSAGE_ANALYSIS ma JOIN MESSAGE m ON ma.message_id = m.message_id JOIN CHAT_ROOM cr ON m.chat_room_id = cr.chat_room_id WHERE cr.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ma.analyzed_at DESC

SELECT analysis_id as analysisId, message_id as messageId, dominant_emotion_id as dominantEmotionId, risk_level as riskLevel, is_high_risk as isHighRisk, recommended_action as recommendedAction, analyzed_at as analyzedAt FROM MESSAGE_ANALYSIS WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId}
